name: evidence-based-literature-review
description: Connector-agnostic bilingual Arabic/English protocol for rigorous, evidence-based academic literature reviews that searches, deduplicates, screens, independently verifies DOI/metadata, critically appraises studies, builds an evidence matrix, synthesizes findings, classifies research gaps, audits citations, and delivers narrative, critical, integrative, scoping or genuinely systematic/PRISMA-aligned reviews. Use when the user asks for a literature review, related-work section, theoretical background, research gaps, an evidence matrix, reference/DOI verification inside a review, or a Master's/PhD chapter (e.g. 'اكتب مراجعة أدبيات عن', 'الدراسات السابقة', 'الفجوة البحثية', 'مراجعة منهجية PRISMA', 'write a literature review on'). Do not use for summarizing a single paper, formatting a reference list with no review, or general essays that need no scholarly sources.

use_when: Write a literature review, related-work section, research or theoretical background
Conduct a narrative, critical, integrative, scoping, systematic or PRISMA-aligned review
Find scholarly papers and synthesize them, or update an existing review
Identify research gaps, contradictions, theoretical trends or methodological weaknesses, or map a field's development
Build an evidence/study matrix or verify references and DOI metadata within a review
Prepare a Master's/PhD chapter or publication-ready evidence synthesis
do_not_use_when: Summarizing or critiquing a single paper (do it directly)
Formatting a reference list with no review to write (apply the citation style directly)
General essays or creative writing that need no scholarly sources
Requests to fabricate, pad or misrepresent evidence (refuse that part)

references.title: Integrity Rules and Shared Operational Rules
references.summary: The 20 integrity rules, source hierarchy, evidence language, stop conditions and completion standard (EN/AR). Read at the start of every review.

references.title: Tool Routing and Capability Check
references.summary: Three-layer architecture, capability-based tool router, fallback protocol and tool neutrality (EN/AR). Read in step 1.

references.title: Review Specification
references.summary: Topic and language rules, smart defaults, customization and review-type classification (EN/AR). Read in steps 2-3.

references.title: Search Model, Eligibility, Search and Screening
references.summary: Question decomposition, frameworks, search bank, eligibility, layered search, deduplication and screening (EN/AR). Read in steps 4-5.

references.title: Verification, Critical Appraisal and Evidence Matrix
references.summary: Bibliographic verification hierarchy, appraisal instruments and evidence-matrix fields (EN/AR). Read in steps 6-7.

references.title: Synthesis, Research Gaps and Theory
references.summary: Analytical synthesis, 12-type gap taxonomy and theoretical analysis (EN/AR). Read in step 8.

references.title: Systematic and PRISMA Protocol
references.summary: Protocol items, real-count flow data, honest downgrading and report structure (EN/AR). Read only for systematic/PRISMA work.

references.title: Citation Audit, Writing, Outputs and Quality Gate
references.summary: Citation audit, structures, writing standards, outputs, Markdown + Word delivery and final quality gate (EN/AR). Read in steps 10-11.
